희귀질환자 의료비 지원사업

대상
아래의 조건 모두 충족자 ① '희귀질환자 의료비 지원사업' 대상질환자 ② 국민건강보험 '산정특례 등록자' ③ 환자가구·부양의무자가구의 소득 및 재산기준 충족자
지원내용
요양급여 중 본인부담금(진료비, 만성신장병 요양비 등) 간병비 및 특수식이 구입비

온라인(헬프라인 홈페이지) 또는 방문 신청 노량진 구청사(동작구 장승배기로 161) 4층 마음건강과 치매예방팀

마음건강과 02-820-9588

Medical-cost support for rare-disease patients

Eligibility
Must meet all of the following ① Covered by the Rare-Disease Medical-Cost Support Program ② Registered for National Health Insurance's special copay-reduction program ③ Meets the income/asset criteria for the patient's and the supporting-relative's households
Support
Co-payments under medical benefits (treatment costs, chronic-kidney-disease care costs, etc.) Caregiving costs and special dietary-food costs
How to apply
Online (Helpline website) or visit in person 4F, Dementia Prevention Team, Mind Health Division, Noryangjin District Office (161 Jangseungbaegi-ro)
Contact
Mind Health Division 02-820-9588

Sindaebang Health Sub-center is relocating

We'll keep protecting residents' health with closer services and expanded health programs.

Opens
Planned for Nov 23, 2026 (Mon) ※ The current office operates as normal through Nov 20 (Fri) ※ The move date may change depending on construction — please call ahead before visiting.
New address
4F, 10-4 Yeouidaebang-ro 24-gil, Dongjak-gu (Dongjak Boramae Station Presente)
Contact
Sindaebang Health Sub-center 02-820-9691

Along with the move, a new AI Seoul Fitness Center opens, using AI fitness-testing equipment to measure strength, cardio-endurance and more and offer tailored fitness management — we hope residents make good use of it.

November Walk-On Challenge — 'The last challenge of 2026! Building a healthy walking habit'

Runs
Nov 1 (Sun) – Dec 30 (Wed)
Eligibility
Dongjak residents and people working in Dongjak-gu
What
Walk 120,000 steps during the period
How to join
Install the 'Walk-On' app → join the 'Let's Walk, Dongjak' community → join 'The last challenge of 2026! Building a healthy walking habit' After completing the mission, tap 'Enter' — a prize drawing follows among entrants
Contact
Health Promotion Div. 02-820-9593, 9596

독감(인플루엔자) 예방접종, 언제가 가장 좋을까요?

접종시기
10월 ~ 11월 초 ※ 늦어도 11월 안에는 접종을 완료해 주세요!
유행 시기
11월 ~ 이듬해 4월
항체 형성
접종 후 약 2주 소요
효과 유지
평균 6개월 지속

인플루엔자 무료 예방접종

접종대상
[국가] 어린이(생후 6개월~14세), 임신부(임신 주수 관계 없음), 어르신(65세 이상) [지자체] 기초생활수급자, 1~3급 장애인, 국가유공자, 보훈보상대상자, 통장 동작구 소재 시설 종사자(사회복지시설·산후조리원 종사자, 환경공무관 등)
준비물
신분증 (임신부는 산모수첩 또는 임신확인서 지참)

위탁의료기관 → 예방접종도우미(nip.kdca.go.kr)에서 확인 가능 ※ 동작구 보건소, 사당/신대방 보건지소에서는 접종하지 않습니다.

김장철 식중독 예방 실천 요령

  • 식재료 세척은 흐르는 물에 꼼꼼하게!
  • 칼과 도마는 용도별로 따로따로!
  • 생굴 등 해산물 취급 시 '노로바이러스' 주의!
  • 조리 전후로 손 씻기와 도구 소독은 철저히!
  • 곁들여 먹는 수육은 속까지 푹 익히기!

When is the best time for a flu shot?

Window
October - early November ※ Please be vaccinated by the end of November at the latest!
Flu season
November - April
Antibodies form
About 2 weeks after the shot
Protection lasts
About 6 months on average

Free flu vaccination

Eligibility
[National] children (6 months-14), pregnant women (any week of pregnancy), seniors 65+ [Local] basic-livelihood recipients, people with grade 1-3 disabilities, national merit recipients, veterans'-support recipients, neighborhood chiefs staff at Dongjak facilities (social-welfare facilities, postpartum care centers, sanitation workers, etc.)
Bring
Photo ID (pregnant women: maternity passport or pregnancy confirmation)
Where
Designated clinics - check nip.kdca.go.kr for a list ※ Not available at the Health Center or the Sadang/Sindaebang sub-centers.
Vaccine
Trivalent influenza vaccine

Food-safety tips for kimjang season

  • Rinse ingredients thoroughly under running water!
  • Use separate knives and cutting boards by food type!
  • Watch for norovirus when handling oysters and other seafood!
  • Wash hands and sanitize tools before and after cooking!
  • Cook boiled-pork side dishes all the way through!

2026년 정신건강 명사 초청 특강 「마음건강을 돌보는 시간」2026 Mental-Health Guest Lecture Series — 'A time to care for your mind'

날씨가 쌀쌀해지며 햇빛 받는 시간이 줄어들어 행복 호르몬(세르토닌)은 감소하고, 수면 호르몬(멜라토닌)은 증가합니다. 가을 타는 것처럼 우울감이 느껴지는 것은 자연스러운 변화이지만, 2주 동안 지속된다면 동작구보건소 마음건강과의 문을 두드려주세요. 마음이 힘들 때, 함께 하겠습니다.

마음건강 자가검진 (우울선별검진)

  • 평소보다 기분이 가라앉고 우울하다.
  • 잠을 잘 못자거나 자꾸 잠이 온다.
  • 입맛이 달라지고 쉽게 피곤해진다.
  • 사람들을 만나기 싫고 혼자 있고 싶다.

As the weather turns chilly and daylight hours shrink, the 'happiness hormone' serotonin drops while the sleep hormone melatonin rises. Feeling a bit blue as autumn sets in is a natural change, but if it lasts two weeks or more, please reach out to the Health Center's Mind Health Division. When things feel hard, we're here with you.

Four teams, one division

  • Mental Health Team — When things feel hard, we're here with you: adult mental-health counselling · youth mind-health promotion · mental-health counselling vouchers · treatment-cost support
  • Suicide Prevention Team — You don't have to carry a hard heart alone: counselling for high-risk individuals · suicide-prevention education · awareness campaigns · support for bereaved families
  • Youth Mind Health Team — Building young people's minds together: tailored mental-health counselling on work, career and relationships · youth mental-health promotion · early-psychosis program
  • Dementia Prevention Team — A steady companion for seniors: early dementia screening · dementia-prevention programs · dementia medical-cost support · dementia-friendly environments

Mind-health self-check (depression screening)

  • I feel down or depressed more than usual.
  • I'm sleeping poorly, or I keep feeling sleepy.
  • My appetite has changed and I tire easily.
  • I don't want to see people and want to be alone.
